_readme: Speed budgets that fail CI (launch fix plan item 13). Each is 10% above a measured value, capped at LCP 2.5 s, CLS 0.1 and 170 kB of first-load JS per route. Where each number was measured and how to re-measure: docs/launch-day.md, 'Speed budgets'.

pages._measured: GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest runners, safety-net runs 36164618152, 36166201469, 36166205070, 36167714118, 36167723739, 36169163561, 36169165317 (2026-09-25; INP from the last two, after the proxy was fixed). Each budget is the worst single sample x 1.1, rounded up to the metric's resolution: LCP 10 ms, CLS 0.01 (how it is reported everywhere), INP 8 ms (event timing's granularity), images 1 kB. The spec checks the median of three loads.

profile.name: Slow 4G + 4x CPU: Lighthouse's mobile profile (150 ms, 1.6 Mbps down, 750 kbps up)

join.overCap: LCP is the hero globe: on a phone the page asks for its 2400 px WebP (124 kB) because `sizes` paints it at 1000 CSS px, and it shares a 1.6 Mbps link with four fonts. 2.63-2.84 s on the runner, 2.6 s on the Mac. The owner's call: a smaller phone image, or keep the art.

journey12._measured: journey 12 (slow.spec.ts, Slow 3G + 4x CPU) on the same seven runs: 39.8-41.6 s; budget = 41.6 s x 1.1, rounded up to the second. Sandbox only; against the real site it stays 180 s.

statements._measured: readiness sandbox launch corpus, 2026-09-25, from the backend's Server-Timing; statement counts do not depend on the machine
statements.anonymousMeNote: anonymous /api/me must send zero statements: readiness:routes' identity check

cityPage.note: the sandbox's cities are small; a Lima-class page measured 171 statements (docs/capacity/STATUS.md CAP-05), which only real data can re-check

firstLoadJs._measured: gzip -9 of the readiness client build's chunks (src/lib/release/firstLoadJs.mjs), 2026-09-25; a GitHub runner agreed within 0.1 kB on every route
